About Us

The Indian Institute of Information Technology Allahabad (IIIT-A) was
established in 1999, as a center of excellence in Information Technology
(IT) and allied areas. The institute was conferred the "Deemed
University" status by the Government of India in the year 2000. It was
declared as an “Institute of National Importance” by the Act of the
Parliament, Govt. of India in 2014. The Institute has been conceived
with the objective of developing professional expertise and skilled
manpower in IT and areas of allied research. As an apex institute in the
area of IT, IIIT-A has been contributing towards strengthening the
indigenous capability necessary for exploiting profitably and harnessing
multi-dimensional facets of IT and allied areas at all levels, and
attaining expertise to enable the country to emerge as a leading player
in the global arena.

The beautiful 100-acre campus, situated at Deoghat, Jhalwa, designed
meticulously on the Penrose Geometry pattern, is being further topped by
fine landscaping to give an all round soothing effect to create a
stimulating environment. The campus is envisaged to be a fully
residential one, with all its faculty, staff, and students housed in
different pockets. All academic and residential areas are connected to
the Institute network.

How to Reach IIIT Allahabad

By Train Connectivity:

Railway Stations at Prayagraj (erstwhile Allahabad) are as follows :

- 1) Allahabad Junction (PRYJ) – Abt. 7 kms from Platform No 1 side
- 2) Subedar Ganj Railway Station ( SFG) – Abt. 3 Kms from either sides
- 3) Prayag (PRG) – Abt. 13 Kms. from Campus
- 4) Allahabad City (ALY) (also popularly known as Rambagh Stn) – Abt.
  10 Kms from Campus
- 5) Prayag Ghat (PYG) (also popularly known as Daraganj Stn) – Abt. 14
  Kms from Campus
- 6) Jhusi (JI) – Abt 20 Kms. from Campus
- 7) Chheoki (ACOI) – Abt. 16 Kms. from Campus
- 8) Naini (NYN) – Abt.19 Kms. from Campus

The IIIT Allahabad campus is located at Jhalwa (Peepalgaon Road),
Allahabad. Allahabad Jn. Railway Station is the first choice for
reaching IIIT Allahabad followed by Subedar Ganj. Allahabad Junction is
very well connected by Trains from all major places like Delhi, Kolkata,
Guwahati, Mumbai, Chennai etc. Indian Railway services to Prayagraj are
excellent and quite comfortable. Best is to alight on Platform No. 1
side of Prayagraj Junction and hire an auto rickshaw for about Rs. 200,
depending upon day-night timings of your arrival. Ola Taxi Service is
also available from Platform No. 1 (locally called Chowk side) and also
from Platform No. 6/10 (locally called Civil Lines side).

By Air Connectivity:

Allahabad is served by Bamrauli Airport, having the code IXD. Direct
flights from Delhi (DEL), Bangalore, Mumbai, Raipur, Kolkata are
available from here. It is about 4 kms from the Institute Campus. Ola
Taxi again is available in between the Airport terminal and Institute
Campus.

By Road Connectivity:

Own Conveyance – IIIT Allahabad Campus is accessible from the main Grand
Trunk Road that connects Kanpur to Lucknow. Its 200 Kms from Kanpur and
abt 203 Kms from Lucknow (The state Capital). As an identification
point, take the road turning that is just opposite to the Dhoomanganj
Police Station on the GT Road and travel 2.9 Kms on the self guiding
road, so as to reach the Gate No. 2 Entrance Gate (Main Gate) of the
Institute.

State Roadways Bus – Alight at the Civil Lines Bus Stand, which is
connected to all districts of Uttar Pradesh and also by Sleeper Buses
from New Delhi. Civil Lines Bus Stand is about 10 Kms from the Institute
Campus, from where local Autos / Battery Rickshaw as well as OLA Taxi is
available round the clock. Shared Auto service is also available till
upto Dhooman Ganj Police Station, from where another shared auto can be
hired to reach Jhalwa Crossing, which is about 1 Km from the Institute
Campus. Battery Rickshaws ply from there to Institute Campus. Reserved
Autos are available from almost anywhere to anywhere, in Prayagraj
(Allahabad).

6. Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) - Regular Track

 

Ph.D. in IT / ECE / Applied Science / Management Studies

Post-Graduate Entry Pathway: Candidates holding an M.Tech. / M.Pharm. /
M.Sc. / MCA / MBA / M.Com. or equivalent degree must have secured at
least 60% marks cumulatively (or 6.0 CGPI on a 10-point scale) at the
time of application. Candidates with national exam qualifications (GATE,
NET, JRF, CSIR, ICMR, or CAT) are exempted from Stage-I testing.
Non-GATE/NET candidates must clear the IIITA-PET computer-based
screening exam.

Direct Ph.D. Entry Pathway (After 4-Year Bachelor's): Direct admission
after a 4-year undergraduate degree requires the candidate to have
secured at least 70% marks cumulatively (or 7.0 CGPI on a 10-point
scale) at the time of application submission.

 

7. Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) - Working Professional Track

 

Ph.D. in IT / ECE / Applied Science / Management Studies (WP Mode)

Eligibility Criteria: Open to professionals actively working across
Industries, Corporate sectors, R&D Laboratories, Government/Private
Institutions, NGOs, or Banks. Qualifying national exams like GATE, NET,
or CAT is not mandatory. Candidates are completely exempted from the
Stage-I written exam and evaluated solely on Stage-II Personal
Interviews.

Academic & Experience Benchmarks:

- Must hold a B.Tech. / B.Pharm. / M.Tech. / M.Sc. / MCA / MBA / M.Com.
  or equivalent degree with a minimum of 60% marks or 6.0 CGPI.
- Must have at least 3 years of total professional work experience at
  the time of application (reduced to 2 years for graduates from
  Institutes of National Importance).
- Mandatory Documentation: Submission of an official No Objection
  Certificate (NOC) from the employer supporting research on a
  part-time/full-time basis, and an institutional Supervisor Acceptance
  Letter.

How to Reach IIIT Allahabad

By Train Connectivity:

Railway Stations at Prayagraj (erstwhile Allahabad) are as follows :

  • 1) Allahabad Junction (PRYJ) – Abt. 7 kms from Platform No 1 side
  • 2) Subedar Ganj Railway Station ( SFG) – Abt. 3 Kms from either sides
  • 3) Prayag (PRG) – Abt. 13 Kms. from Campus
  • 4) Allahabad City (ALY) (also popularly known as Rambagh Stn) – Abt. 10 Kms from Campus
  • 5) Prayag Ghat (PYG) (also popularly known as Daraganj Stn) – Abt. 14 Kms from Campus
  • 6) Jhusi (JI) – Abt 20 Kms. from Campus
  • 7) Chheoki (ACOI) – Abt. 16 Kms. from Campus
  • 8) Naini (NYN) – Abt.19 Kms. from Campus

The IIIT Allahabad campus is located at Jhalwa (Peepalgaon Road), Allahabad. Allahabad Jn. Railway Station is the first choice for reaching IIIT Allahabad followed by Subedar Ganj. Allahabad Junction is very well connected by Trains from all major places like Delhi, Kolkata, Guwahati, Mumbai, Chennai etc. Indian Railway services to Prayagraj are excellent and quite comfortable. Best is to alight on Platform No. 1 side of Prayagraj Junction and hire an auto rickshaw for about Rs. 200, depending upon day-night timings of your arrival. Ola Taxi Service is also available from Platform No. 1 (locally called Chowk side) and also from Platform No. 6/10 (locally called Civil Lines side).

By Air Connectivity:

Allahabad is served by Bamrauli Airport, having the code IXD. Direct flights from Delhi (DEL), Bangalore, Mumbai, Raipur, Kolkata are available from here. It is about 4 kms from the Institute Campus. Ola Taxi again is available in between the Airport terminal and Institute Campus.

By Road Connectivity:

Own Conveyance – IIIT Allahabad Campus is accessible from the main Grand Trunk Road that connects Kanpur to Lucknow. Its 200 Kms from Kanpur and abt 203 Kms from Lucknow (The state Capital). As an identification point, take the road turning that is just opposite to the Dhoomanganj Police Station on the GT Road and travel 2.9 Kms on the self guiding road, so as to reach the Gate No. 2 Entrance Gate (Main Gate) of the Institute.

State Roadways Bus – Alight at the Civil Lines Bus Stand, which is connected to all districts of Uttar Pradesh and also by Sleeper Buses from New Delhi. Civil Lines Bus Stand is about 10 Kms from the Institute Campus, from where local Autos / Battery Rickshaw as well as OLA Taxi is available round the clock. Shared Auto service is also available till upto Dhooman Ganj Police Station, from where another shared auto can be hired to reach Jhalwa Crossing, which is about 1 Km from the Institute Campus. Battery Rickshaws ply from there to Institute Campus. Reserved Autos are available from almost anywhere to anywhere, in Prayagraj (Allahabad).
